whole.what_a_cell_is: Most groups in this register are lists of rules an operator follows. APPRAISAL is a CELL: a reusable unit that takes a scope and produces eight readings over it, in four paired axes, where neither end of an axis is sufficient alone. It is named for the organism's functional unit because that is what it is — the faculties are its organelles, and it can be run by the Transformation Office over a transformation's scope or by Change Control over a change's, as well as over the delivery plan itself. Its structures are FOUR AXES of two ends each and ONE SPINE of three: an axis is a dyad whose ends check each other, a spine is a triad whose middle is the present. The Owner's cognitive map is the source of the spine — Past ↔ Present ↔ Future, Memory ↔ Perception ↔ Imagination, Learning ↔ Orientation ↔ Planning.

spine.why_a_spine_and_not_an_axis: time has a MIDDLE. The four axes are dyads whose ends check each other; this is a triad, and its middle is the present — the faculty this cell was built without.
spine.neither_end_alone: retrospection without observation is nostalgia; prospection without observation is fantasy; observation without either is drift.

whole.reconciliation: Neither end of an axis is sufficient alone. REFLECTION without REASONING is a diary and reasoning without reflection is invention; ATTRIBUTION without RECOGNITION is a list of sources and recognition without attribution is a pattern nobody can check; FORESIGHT without HINDSIGHT is a promise and hindsight without foresight is regret; INTROSPECTION without EXTROSPECTION is a platform grading its own homework and extrospection without introspection is a platform that cannot say what it does not know. Read the pairs together or the cell has not run. And the SPINE is read as a whole for the same reason: RETROSPECTION without OBSERVATION is nostalgia, PROSPECTION without OBSERVATION is fantasy, and observation without either is drift.
whole.this_cell_never_says: that a scope is sound, ready, or on track. Two of its eight faculties are largely judgement and say so, and the evidence for a delivery is a guard that was made to fail first.

lessons.rule: REFLECTION: read the record of what was actually DONE before forming any view of where things stand. A view formed from activity is not a view of progress.
REASONING: derive the ORDER from constraints, never from priority alone. An item held behind another cannot be closed by working it, however high it scores.
ATTRIBUTION: every claim names its PRODUCER and the round that made it. A figure with no attribution cannot be re-measured, only believed.
RECOGNITION: name the CLASS a finding belongs to before acting on it. A finding treated as unique is fixed at its site, and a site fix is made again.
FORESIGHT: project in ROUNDS, from one forecaster, and name the projection's weakest input in the same breath as the number.
HINDSIGHT: check the projection's own BASIS against what happened. A rate measured on one population and applied to another is an assumption, and the assumption is testable.
INTROSPECTION: state what the platform's own record CANNOT see. A platform that reports only what it holds is grading its own homework.
EXTROSPECTION: read the TREE, not the record, before believing the record. The record is a claim about the world; the world is checkable.
RETROSPECTION: read the record for its PATTERN, not its totals. A count says what happened; a pattern says what keeps happening.
OBSERVATION: read what is happening NOW, from the live system, before inferring anything about it. Inference without observation is the most expensive habit available.
PROSPECTION: enumerate what COULD happen and refuse to rank it. A possibility given a probability has been turned into a prediction, and this platform has exactly one forecaster.

extrospection.limits: It reads the last 400 commits and only commits whose subject declares a round. A row carrying no files, or found by a round the subject does not name, is invisible to it.

retrospection.basis: read from the register's own record. The rows in this scope, by status: built or satisfied, dropped as refuted, and why each closed where it records why. The rounds, and whether the backlog is growing, over the whole register: which round closed each row and which round found it
retrospection.closure_kind_basis: 226 of 271 closed row(s) record WHY they closed. The rest predate the field (W561) and are counted as not_recorded rather than as built — a round that closed six rows by measuring them already-satisfied is not the round that closed six by building, and guessing which is which would invent the distinction this field exists to stop inventing
retrospection.what_the_pattern_means: 6 of 277 resolved rows were DROPPED as refuted rather than built, a refutation share of 0.022. A row dropped as false and a row closed because it was already satisfied are both work the register ASKED FOR and did not need — which is why the open count is an upper bound on the work and not a measure of it (M-FCAST-02). The totals cannot show this, because closing a satisfied row and closing a built one are the same increment. Across the whole register, 52 round(s) closed nothing and only registered findings: those add work rather than burning it, and counting them as build rounds would understate the rate.
retrospection.limits: this reads STATUS, not cause. It cannot tell a row closed because it was built from one closed because it was already satisfied — that distinction lives in the closing round's own words, and recording it is what would make this faculty sharper.

observation.basis: THE HEARTBEAT IS STOPPED. Nothing is being operated, nothing is being screened, and the figures above are the last ones it recorded rather than current ones. A stopped beat is not a healthy zero.
observation.limits: a reading of NOW is stale the moment it is taken, and this one does not re-read. It says when it was taken so a reader can judge that, which is the only honest thing available.

phase.what_a_cell_is: Most groups in this register are lists of rules an operator follows. APPRAISAL is a CELL: a reusable unit that takes a scope and produces eight readings over it, in four paired axes, where neither end of an axis is sufficient alone. It is named for the organism's functional unit because that is what it is — the faculties are its organelles, and it can be run by the Transformation Office over a transformation's scope or by Change Control over a change's, as well as over the delivery plan itself. Its structures are FOUR AXES of two ends each and ONE SPINE of three: an axis is a dyad whose ends check each other, a spine is a triad whose middle is the present. The Owner's cognitive map is the source of the spine — Past ↔ Present ↔ Future, Memory ↔ Perception ↔ Imagination, Learning ↔ Orientation ↔ Planning.

spine.why_a_spine_and_not_an_axis: time has a MIDDLE. The four axes are dyads whose ends check each other; this is a triad, and its middle is the present — the faculty this cell was built without.
spine.neither_end_alone: retrospection without observation is nostalgia; prospection without observation is fantasy; observation without either is drift.

phase.reconciliation: Neither end of an axis is sufficient alone. REFLECTION without REASONING is a diary and reasoning without reflection is invention; ATTRIBUTION without RECOGNITION is a list of sources and recognition without attribution is a pattern nobody can check; FORESIGHT without HINDSIGHT is a promise and hindsight without foresight is regret; INTROSPECTION without EXTROSPECTION is a platform grading its own homework and extrospection without introspection is a platform that cannot say what it does not know. Read the pairs together or the cell has not run. And the SPINE is read as a whole for the same reason: RETROSPECTION without OBSERVATION is nostalgia, PROSPECTION without OBSERVATION is fantasy, and observation without either is drift.
phase.this_cell_never_says: that a scope is sound, ready, or on track. Two of its eight faculties are largely judgement and say so, and the evidence for a delivery is a guard that was made to fail first.

lessons.rule: REFLECTION: read the record of what was actually DONE before forming any view of where things stand. A view formed from activity is not a view of progress.
REASONING: derive the ORDER from constraints, never from priority alone. An item held behind another cannot be closed by working it, however high it scores.
ATTRIBUTION: every claim names its PRODUCER and the round that made it. A figure with no attribution cannot be re-measured, only believed.
RECOGNITION: name the CLASS a finding belongs to before acting on it. A finding treated as unique is fixed at its site, and a site fix is made again.
FORESIGHT: project in ROUNDS, from one forecaster, and name the projection's weakest input in the same breath as the number.
HINDSIGHT: check the projection's own BASIS against what happened. A rate measured on one population and applied to another is an assumption, and the assumption is testable.
INTROSPECTION: state what the platform's own record CANNOT see. A platform that reports only what it holds is grading its own homework.
EXTROSPECTION: read the TREE, not the record, before believing the record. The record is a claim about the world; the world is checkable.
RETROSPECTION: read the record for its PATTERN, not its totals. A count says what happened; a pattern says what keeps happening.
OBSERVATION: read what is happening NOW, from the live system, before inferring anything about it. Inference without observation is the most expensive habit available.
PROSPECTION: enumerate what COULD happen and refuse to rank it. A possibility given a probability has been turned into a prediction, and this platform has exactly one forecaster.

hand_off.kept_basis: this appraisal is a reading made at this call. The route writes nothing, so it is not stored and no later appraisal can read this one
hand_off.authorises_basis: this route files, approves and applies nothing. A person may send one of its recommendations, and that route appraises the scope again and SUBMITS one record; the method's other filers also only submit. Change Control decides
hand_off.next_route_basis: to act on this reading a person files a change there, naming the affected systems. Change Control attaches the appraisal of the scope those systems point at (`scope_appraisal`, which is never a gate), and a review decides the change
hand_off.method_filers_basis: the 5 method routes that can raise a change, each on a person's request (a confirmed defect, a recorded breach, a proposed correction, a batch of lessons, one recommendation of an appraisal). One of them reads an appraisal, and it appraises the scope again at the call and files what that reading says
hand_off.not_established: whether an implemented change did what it was filed for. The status and effect listed here are Change Control's own record of what it decided and applied; nothing re-reads the changed state after implementation, and this appraisal reads no outcome beyond them
hand_off.statement: no Change Control record carries an appraisal of P3: nothing that has been filed points at it. This appraisal does not change that - it files nothing
